$comment: Single source of truth for which block kinds this build compiles and which of them the block palette offers (issue #313). Generated outputs are produced from this file by scripts/gen-param-schema.mjs --target=effects - never hand-edit them: packages/core/include/openaxe/generated/enabled_blocks.h, packages/core/generated/block_sources.cmake, and apps/web/src/effects/generatedBlockConfig.ts. Two independent flags, because they are two independent states: `compiled` decides whether the DSP source is handed to the compiler at all, `inPalette` decides whether a user can place the block. Before this file existed the second was expressed by commenting entries out of apps/web/src/components/grid/blockOptions.ts while the DSP still compiled into every binary - ring-mod and granular-delay are exactly that case, and are why the two flags are not one. `compiled: false` implies `inPalette: false` (the generator enforces it). A kind with no `cppFile` has no DSP source of its own - it is routing, a NAM-model kind, or handled inside engine.cpp - so it cannot be compiled out and the generator rejects `compiled: false` for it. `enumName` is the openaxe::graph::BlockKind enumerator and the key is the wire string used by presets and the state document (src/serialization/rig_state.cpp owns that mapping); both are repeated here so the generator never has to re-derive them from C++. Changing `compiled` requires rebuilding the checked-in WASM (bash scripts/build-core-wasm.sh) - the app asks the running core via nam_studio_block_kind_compiled at startup and logs an error if the artifact disagrees with this file.

blocks.$comment_ping_pong: Compiled but not offered - the palette entry has been commented out since it landed. Issue #314 deletes the kind outright and folds ping-pong into the Delay block as a stereo mode.
blocks.$comment_reverb: The four Dragonfly algorithms are separate CMake targets with their own include paths and a C++14 override (see CMakeLists.txt), so this one entry gates the whole DRAGONFLY_ALGOS block rather than a single source file.
blocks.$comment_hidden_effects: Compiled today, hidden today. ring-mod aliases badly (no oversampling on the carrier - issue #318) and granular-delay runs only two grain voices with periodic pseudo-jitter (issue #321). Turn inPalette on once those land; turn compiled off to reclaim the WASM bytes in the meantime.
blocks.$comment_nam_kinds: The NAM-capture gear kinds and cab/mixer/splitter and the Send/Return relays. No DSP source of their own (nam_amp.cpp and convolver.cpp back several kinds each, and routing lives in engine.cpp), so they are palette-gated only. `outboard` and `splitter` were the other two commented-out palette entries.
